title: FilterFX: LFO-Controlled State-Variable Filter Pedal
summary: Pedal project: a 12 dB/oct state-variable filter with lowpass, bandpass and highpass outputs, swept by the STOMPLFO chip with eight waveforms, tap tempo and external sync. Includes sound examples, PCB and build documents.

sources.title: FilterFX – 12dB/oct LP/BP/HP LFO filter with 8 waveshapes
sources.author: Tom Wiltshire (Electric Druid)
